title: HAREM！RANCH LIFE
description:
This is a relaxing farm RPG game where you can earn money by collecting and raising livestock! 

Interact with adorable villagers to increase your popularity in the village through chatting and giving gifts. 

Please enjoy a cozy farm life in this small village!

Take care of livestock to harvest high-quality milk and eggs. 

The larger your farm, the more livestock you can raise.

Upgrade your house by collecting materials and eventually own a luxurious mansion.

▪️Game featuresFarm management RPG

No ultimate goal! Just enjoy a leisurely life.

Cultivate relationships with villagers and become a family!
